name: 3D-BrainCT
description: 3D-BrainCT is a dataset and evaluation framework for 3D brain CT radiology report generation using multimodal large language models. It includes 18,885 text-scan pairs and introduces the FORTE evaluation scheme to capture clinical diagnostic quality, enabling anatomy-aware model fine-tuning and robust assessment of generated radiology reports.
reputation: A specialized medical multimodal benchmark for 3D brain CT report generation that is useful in radiology research, but not yet widely adopted outside that niche.
notes: Focuses on 3D medical imaging report generation; traditional LLM metrics insufficient, uses feature-oriented radiology task evaluation.
